CLINICAL AYURVEDIC SCIENCE

The 4-Pillar Method for Lasting Joint Restoration.

Our clinical protocols focus on identifying root imbalances, easing joint stiffness, supporting nerve comfort, and promoting natural functional mobility through classical Ayurvedic principles.

01

Snehana (Deep Tissue Lubrication)

Application of classical herbal decoctions and medicated oils cooked with anti-inflammatory roots (Mahanarayan and Ksheerabala) to nourish dry joint capsules.

Benefit: Nourishes dry joint capsules and eases friction
02

Swedana (Herbal Fomentation)

Targeted thermal steam with medicinal herbs opens micro-circulatory channels (Srotas), dilates blood vessels, and eliminates accumulated metabolic toxins (Ama).

Benefit: Promotes micro-circulation and relieves joint stiffness
03

Janu Basti & Kati Basti (Bio-Reservoir)

A specialized herbal dough ring holds warm medicated oil directly over the knee joint (Janu) or lumbar spine (Kati) for sustained deep cellular tissue penetration.

Benefit: Relieves localized lumbar tension and nourishes surrounding tissues
04

Shaman Aushadhi (Internal Restoration)

Classical Ayurvedic herb-mineral formulations (Yograj Guggulu, Shallaki, Hadjod) taken internally to support bone and joint vitality, reduce chronic inflammation, and maintain mobility.

Benefit: Supports bone & joint tissue vitality
